# Vendored: qr-code-shapes

Unmodified copy of `src/` from [koloqr/qr-code-shapes](https://github.com/koloqr/qr-code-shapes)
at commit `cf63c28` (v0.1.0). MIT licensed — see `LICENSE` in this folder.
